node_definition.done_when: A new tests/test_queue_landing.py shows, with no session, coordinator or follower alive: a delivered implementation run whose stored review read the delivered head and is accepted by _review_accepts_promotion is landed through the same crew land path a coordinator calls, serialised by the index.lock retry in reckon/crew/merge.py and the per-run promotion lease, and its awaiting-upstream downstream request then launches; the merged-head gate executes through the srun shim, not in the service process; a run whose review read an older head is not landed; a below-floor review raises an obligation on the owning session and does not land; a refused landing leaves the run unlanded with the guard named and no silent retry; a second review of an unchanged head is refused. The landing pass lives in a new reckon/crew/queue_landing.py and runs on the same loop as admit_until_stopped. The test files importing each changed module add no failures against the base revision, measured serially as a delta with the base and head logs under the run directory; ruff check and ruff format --check pass on the changed paths.
